note: Entries with no oracle expression, and why. Read sql/oracle/README.md first.
There is no percentage and no threshold here on purpose. A threshold is the
'broad set with hidden assumptions' this layer exists not to be: 94% coverage
is a number that sounds like progress and names nothing. Every supported entry
either has an expression that reaches it -- proved by a trace of Map::entry(),
not by a header claiming so -- or is listed below with a reason a person wrote.
The list is empty, and that is the state to keep it in. When M5 adds
postgresql and sqlite, each new entry will arrive needing either an expression
or a line here, which is the obligation the gate exists to make visible.
Refusals need nothing: a refusal has no semantics to check, it is the absence
of them. The gate only counts entries that are objects.
